Name: mondluna's Seal for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Bork bork! Permissions were open for mondluna's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6650]seals pet[/url] mod so I turned it into a farm animal! Original mod is by modluna and the new varieties are by jonbow!

Seals live in barns and produce shrimp and squid. They can be purchased from Marnie.

There are now 4 varieties of seal! You can now have white seals, brown seals, walruses, and sea lions thanks to jonbow!

Enjoy!
